entities.name: St. Lazarus Roman Catholic Church, al-Eizariya
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: St. Lazarus Church is a Roman Catholic church located in the West Bank town of al-Eizariya, identified with biblical Bethany. The church is close to what Christian tradition holds to be the tomb of Lazarus and the site of the house of Mary, Martha, and Lazarus.
